B.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match fraction units
skills.definition: Create comparable fractional parts by finding a common denominator and rewriting fractions, or by rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0 over the needed denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions before subtracting.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d so the fractional parts can be subtracted.
Tag when mixed-number fractional parts are rewritten to a shared denominator before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have the same denominator and no rewriting is done.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has started.
Do not tag for simplifying the final result.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard whole-plus-proper-fraction form before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number such as 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 is converted to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver explicitly states 'normalize' or performs the equivalent rewrite because the fractional part is improper.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0/d.
Do not tag for finding common denominators among proper fractions.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping during subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the forms are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when the solution computes an intermediate negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the prior step of creating common denominators or rewriting forms.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping to fix a negative fractional part.
Do not tag for reducing the final answer to lowest terms.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Resolve a negative or insufficient fractional part by borrowing 1 whole into fractional units and express the final result in lowest terms or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 whole is borrowed/regrouped into d/d or equivalent fractional units to continue subtraction.
Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction or mixed number to lowest terms.
Tag when a zero fraction is reduced to 0 or a whole number result is stated after simplification.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for direct subtraction that needs no borrowing and no simplification.
Do not tag for merely combining already-final whole and fraction parts without regrouping or reduction.
Do not tag for initial normalization of an improper mixed number.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator for unlike fractional parts.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple subtraction of numerators after common denominators are already established.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed-number fractional part unless it also includes creating equivalent fractions to match denominators.

skills.name: Normalize composite forms
skills.definition: Rewrite whole numbers or nonstandard mixed numbers into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a zero fractional part or converting a mixed number with an improper fraction part to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole number plus 0 over a chosen denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is converted to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly decomposed into whole and fractional parts to set up subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction of already-ready whole and fractional parts.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has produced a negative fractional part.
Do not tag denominator equalization unless the main action is rewriting to a common denominator.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the forms are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when the result is combined from the computed whole and fractional differences without regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is first creating common denominators.
Do not tag steps whose main purpose is borrowing/regrouping to fix a negative fractional difference.
Do not tag simplification to lowest terms after subtraction.

skills.name: Regroup or simplify result
skills.definition: Either borrow/regroup across the whole and fractional parts when the fractional subtraction is negative, or reduce the resulting fraction/mixed number to lowest terms including whole-number results such as 0 or 1.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is borrowed from the whole part and converted into denominator-over-denominator to continue subtraction.
Tag when a fraction or mixed number result is simplified to lowest terms.
Tag when a zero fractional result is simplified to a whole number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of whole numbers as having 0 fractional parts.
Do not tag finding a common denominator.
Do not tag straightforward subtraction that does not involve regrouping or simplification.

A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting when the original denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator.
Tag when fractional parts are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtraction.
Tag for both pure-fraction items and mixed-number items with unlike fractional denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed-number part if it does not involve creating a common denominator between the two quantities.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with matched denominators and/or subtract whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution separately subtracts whole parts and fraction parts without borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to find a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps used to fix a negative fractional difference.
Do not tag final simplification or recombination unless actual subtraction is performed in that step.

skills.name: Regroup or normalize
skills.definition: Rewrite a quantity into an equivalent form to make subtraction possible, including normalizing mixed numbers with improper fraction parts or borrowing 1 whole into fractional units.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator to set up mixed-number subtraction.
Tag when 1 whole is borrowed/regrouped into fractional units because the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction once the numbers are already in workable form.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion between unlike denominators unless the step is specifically a borrow/regroup action.
Do not tag simplification of the final answer.

skills.name: Simplify and express
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms and express it appropriately as a fraction, mixed number, or whole number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is rewritten as 0 or when a mixed number with zero fractional part is written as a whole number.
Tag when separately obtained whole and fractional results are combined into the final form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that do not change the form of the result.
Do not tag denominator-equalizing conversions done before subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing or normalization steps unless they also explicitly produce the final simplified form.
